makefile.description: The Makefile, relative to the workspace folder. Default: GNUmakefile, makefile or Makefile in the folder.

pathVariables.description: Variables that take a file or folder path. A target takes a path when its recipe uses one of them; the first one in this list wins.

notifications.description: When a finished run shows a notification: always, only when it failed, or never.

hidden.description: Targets never shown or run from the editor. * and ? are wildcards.

confirm.description: Targets that ask for confirmation before they run. * and ? are wildcards.

targets.description: Settings of single targets, by target name.

pathVariable.description: The variable this target takes a path in, overriding the detection; null: the target takes no path.

hidden.description: Hide the target, or show it although a pattern in "hidden" matches it.

confirm.description: Ask before the target runs, or do not although a pattern in "confirm" matches it.

args.description: Variables always passed to this target, as VAR=value.

notifications.description: When a finished run of this target shows a notification, overriding "notifications".
